claim.text: In RLHF the optimal policy is the reference policy times exp(reward / beta), so a small beta lets one token take the rew

spec.explain: Illustrative toy of arXiv 2203.02155: bars show reference policy reweighted by exp(reward/beta). The limit is small beta where one token takes the reward.

questions.q: Predict p_top if beta=0.2 with gap=2?
questions.why: Tests sharp concentration at small beta.

questions.q: What is p_top if beta=4 with gap=2?
questions.why: Tests flattening toward reference at large beta.

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var beta = state.beta; var gap = state.gap; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var r = gap / beta; var e = Math.exp(r); var ptop = e / (1 + e); var th = r - 1; var maxW = w * 0.52; var x0 = w * 0.30; var wMax = 10; var lenW = e / wMax * maxW; var clipped = 0; if (lenW > maxW) { lenW = maxW; clipped = 1; } var lenW2 = 1 / wMax * maxW; var lenP = ptop * maxW; var lenP2 = (1 - ptop) * maxW; var lenR = 0.5 * maxW; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("reference 0.5 / 0.5", 16, 70); ctx.fillText("weight exp(reward/beta)", 16, 140); ctx.fillText("optimal policy", 16, 240); ctx.fillStyle = "#d5cbbd"; ctx.fillRect(x0, 52, lenR, 16); ctx.fillRect(x0, 76, lenR, 16); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(x0, 122, lenW, 18); ctx.fillRect(x0, 148, lenW2, 18); if (clipped === 1) { ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("clipped", x0 + maxW + 8, 136); } ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(x0, 222, lenP, 20); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(x0, 250, lenP2, 20); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("top " + fmt(ptop), x0 + lenP + 8, 237); ctx.fillText("other " + fmt(1 - ptop), x0 + lenP2 + 8, 265); ctx.fillText("gap/beta " + fmt(r), 16, 300); ctx.fillText("p_top " + fmt(ptop), 16, 320); ctx.fillText("gap/beta-1 " + fmt(th), 16, 340); var pth = 2.718281828459045 / (1 + 2.718281828459045); var xt = x0 + pth * maxW; ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; var yy = 218; while (yy < 276) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xt, yy); ctx.lineTo(xt, yy + 6); ctx.stroke(); yy = yy + 10; } ctx.font = "11px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("takeover", xt + 6, 218); if (th > 0) { ctx.fillText("concentrated", 16, 30); } else { ctx.fillText("near reference", 16, 30); } }
